description: Sprint 2 benchmark: full-coverage synthetic contract fixtures across 20 document types, expanding on v1's three-document NDA/lease/employment set.
notes: All source documents are synthetic (no real user or client data). Sample counts per document range 5-8, sized to the number of distinct salient clauses in each fixture. Includes negative questions, numeric-reasoning, and multi-clause-reasoning question types alongside straightforward factual lookups. IPC / Constitution categories remain planned for a later dataset version, not v2.
